title: Heat Exchangers
summary: Shell-and-tube exchangers, condensers, reboilers and other thermal equipment tailored to process conditions.
body:
Heat-transfer equipment is selected around process conditions, thermal duty, allowable pressure drop, fouling considerations and maintainability. Our scope may include shell-and-tube heat exchangers, condensers and reboilers.

What to provide for an RFQ

  • Process streams and flow rates
  • Inlet/outlet temperatures and pressures
  • Heat duty and allowable pressure drop
  • Material, code and inspection requirements
  • Site constraints and preferred arrangement

Thermal design assumptions must be reviewed and confirmed for each project.
seoTitle: Shell & Tube Heat Exchangers | Tongyang Process
seoDescription: Custom heat exchangers, condensers and reboilers designed and manufactured for industrial applications.
